topic: Chapter 585's sake cup pact foreshadows each brother paying for another; Luffy's bill is still unpaid
title: The Brothers' Cup In Chapter 585 Was A Prophecy
description: In chapter 585 Ace, Sabo and Luffy share sake and become brothers, and Sabo immediately sacrifices himself for them. Here's the pattern across chapters 573 and 744 and why Luffy might be next. Do you buy it?
comment: Does Luffy pay the final price for the brothers' cup, or does he break the pattern?

lines.text: The brothers' cup in chapter 585 was a prophecy, and Oda paid it off again and again.

shot.fallback: three boys sharing cups of sake

lines.text: Here's my read, and I think the evidence is brutal.
Chapter 585. Ace pours sake into three cups, and Luffy, Ace and Sabo become sworn brothers.

shot.search: Ace pours sake Luffy Sabo brothers

lines.text: Minutes later, Sabo agrees to go home so Ace and Luffy don't get beaten for him.

shot.search: Sabo returns to noble father Bluejam
shot.fallback: boy in a top hat taken away by nobles

lines.text: That's payment one. Sabo paid for his brothers.
Years later at Marineford, chapter 573, Ace takes Akainu's attack to protect Luffy.

shot.fallback: fire fist user shielding a boy from magma

lines.text: Payment two. Ace paid for Luffy.

shot.fallback: fallen fire user in arms of rubber boy

lines.text: Then in chapter 744, Sabo eats the Mera Mera no Mi, so Ace's fire ends up with another brother.

shot.search: Sabo Mera Mera no Mi Ace fire

lines.text: People say it's just a flashback. But three brothers, three cups, and every sacrifice lands on the next one.
And maybe Oda wrote it as pure backstory. I still say it's too clean to be an accident.
Here's what scares me. Luffy is the one brother who hasn't paid yet.

shot.fallback: rubber boy looking at the sky

lines.text: Because the brothers' cup in chapter 585 was a prophecy...

shot.fallback: three boys sharing cups of sake
